# Keepalive

> Open-source, game-agnostic multiplayer kit: lobby server with join codes, TURN relay, WebRTC data-channel clients for
> JavaScript, .NET and Godot 4 C#. Lockstep or raw messaging, voice and text chat, self-hostable, games stay playable offline.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what Keepalive is, the API on one screen for C# and JS, and the rules
- [examples/tictactoe/README.md](examples/tictactoe/README.md): a single-player browser game to practise on

## Recipes

- [Godot 4 C#](docs/recipes/godot-csharp.md): Host / Join / Browse buttons in a Godot project
- [Browser JS](docs/recipes/js-web.md): the same in a plain web page
- [Generic .NET](docs/recipes/dotnet-generic.md): console or any engine, with the in-memory transport for tests
- [Raw mode](docs/recipes/raw-mode.md): bring your own netcode (host-authoritative, turn-based)
- [Voice and chat](docs/recipes/voice-and-chat.md): push-to-talk, mute, text chat
- [Headless testing](docs/recipes/testing.md): two browser contexts with playwright-core, fake mic
- [Self-host](docs/recipes/self-host.md): run the lobby server and relay yourself

## API reference (generated by docs/build.mjs)

- [JS client](docs/api/js.md): every export of @keepalive/client
- [.NET client](docs/api/dotnet.md): every public type of Keepalive.Core

## Operations

- [Run your own server](deploy/RUN_YOUR_OWN.md): five steps, port table, smoke test
